credit.credit-words: One More Day’s Work for Jesus
WORDS: Anna B. Warner, pub.1869. MUSIC: Robert Lowry, pub.1869. Public Domain.

Whatsoever ye do, do it heartily... for ye serve the Lord Christ. Col. 3:23-24 The night cometh, when no man can work. Jn. 9:4 Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord. 1 Cor. 15:58
